prior._note: Kneser-Ney trigram fitted on every GISLR-Sentences v1 corpus sentence (the deployed prior; the notebooks score held-out folds).

rule._source: docs/reports/sign-to-speech-downstream.md §2.2: beats the θ=0.3 floor on missed, wrong and extra signs and noise on the evaluation signers (GER 0.347 -> 0.320 clean, 0.580 -> 0.547 noisy); about 27 frames of delay on uncertain signs.

_variants_note: Recognizer options on the sign -> speech page (TODO §12.8). A variant is exported only when all its runs are trained; its D3 setting comes from gislr.3.streaming.window-ensemble.ipynb's selection (data/cache/gislr/window_ensemble/parts/<variant>.json) unless given here. The lattice rule below was tuned on C1 and is shared by every variant.

_holistic_delegate_note: CPU (user decision 2026-09-25: the GPU delegate was slower on their machine). "GPU" tries the GPU first and falls back to CPU. ?delegate=GPU|CPU on the page URL overrides it for a comparison.
